# The Jazz Café | NO P2W | NO RESETS

The Jazz Café exists purely out of a passion for bringing back the classic Minecraft survival multiplayer experience from the early 2010s. I started this server as a hobby to create a place where you can build, explore, and forge lasting friendships in a welcoming environment.

I run The Jazz Café in my spare time, working a full-time job alongside it. This server is, and always will be, completely free-to-play and never pay-to-win. My goal is to provide a fun space for everyone, not to make a profit.

Progression on The Jazz Café is powered by a fully gameplay driven upgrade system via **`/shop`**. Instead of locking essential quality of life or powerful automation features (such as chunk collectors) behind real world paywalls, players can permanently unlock features and ranks using the money they earn while playing. This creates a fair, no P2W environment where your progression is directly tied to your dedication and success in the player economy.
